scripts.build:agentcore: rm -rf dist-agentcore && mkdir -p dist-agentcore && esbuild src/agentcore/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --outfile=dist-agentcore/app.js && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist-agentcore/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}) + '\n')"
scripts.package:agentcore: bun run build:agentcore && cd dist-agentcore && zip -q approvaldesk-agentcore.zip app.js package.json
